simple.meaning: חֲגָו (chăgâv) is a Hebrew word meaning “a rift in rocks.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: חֲגָו (H2288) appears 3 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Song of Songs 2:14, with occurrences in Song of Solomon, Jeremiah, Obadiah.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to חֲגָו (H2288) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in חֲגָו (H2288) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: חֲגָו (chăgâv) / H2288 is traced through Song of Songs 2:14, Jeremiah 49:16, Obadiah 1:3 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.

occurrences.englishText: The pride of your heart has deceived you, you who dwell in the clefts of the rock, whose habitation is high, who says in his heart, ‘Who will bring me down to the ground?’
